newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia confectioner Babayevskoye eyes ADR in 97.
newsitem.headline: Russia confectioner Babayevskoye eyes ADR in 97.

text.p: Russian confectionery AO Babayevskoye plans to issue 10 percent of its charter capital as level-one American Depositary Receipts in 1997, board chairman Vladimir Vinogradov said on Monday.

"We plan to issue level-one ADRs in 1997...We will start small, with up to 10 percent (of charter capital)," said Vinogradov, who is also president of one of Russia's top ten banks, Inkombank. Commercial bank Inkombank holds a controlling stake in the factory.
Vinogradoc gave no further details on the issue.
Babayevskoye's charter capital is 417 billion roubles ($72.4 million).
Vinogradov said Inkombank would consider issuing ADRs on the bank's other confectionery holdings, depending on how the Babayevskoye issue went.

Inkombank also holds stakes in Russian confectioneries OAO Rot Front (Moscow), OAO Yuzhnouralskaya Konditerskaya Fabrika (Chelyabinsk), ZAO Sormovskaya Konditerskaya Fabrika (Sormovo, Nizhny Novgorod) and ZAO Novosibirskaya Shokoladnaya Fabrika.
Vinogradov said Inkombank was looking into the possibility of issuing paper on its confectionery and retail holdings.
